blocks.text:
SELECT PLAYER NAME, POSITION, BACK_NO, TEAM_ID, TEAM_NAME
FROM (SELECT A_PLAYER NAME, A.POSITION, A.BACK_NO
, B.TEAM_ID, B.TEAM_NAME
FROM PLAYER A, TEAM B
WHERE B.TEAM_ID = A.TEAM_ID)
WHERE PLAYER NAME LIKE '®%';
